test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following scriptures is NOT a part of Vedic literature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pitakas**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pitakas** are not a part of Vedic literature.
 
• Vedic literature primarily consists of the **Vedas, Brahmanas, Aranyakas, and Upanishads**.
 
• The **Vedas** are the oldest and most authoritative scriptures of Hinduism, composed in ancient Sanskrit.
 
• The **Brahmanas** are prose texts that explain the hymns in the Vedas and are associated with rituals and ceremonies.
 
• The **Aranyakas** are texts that serve as a bridge between the ritualistic Brahmanas and the philosophical Upanishads.
 
• The **Upanishads** are philosophical texts that explore the spiritual ideas and concepts found in the Vedas.
 
• **Pitakas**, on the other hand, are a part of Buddhist scriptures and consist of three "baskets" or collections of teachings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Vedas** are divided into four main categories: Rigveda, Samaveda, Yajurveda, and Atharvaveda.
 
• The **Brahmanas** provide detailed instructions on the performance of rituals and the symbolic significance of the Vedic hymns.
 
• The **Aranyakas** are sometimes referred to as "forest books" and were meant for study in the isolation of the forest.
 
• The **Upanishads** are considered the end part of the Vedas and focus on meditation, morality, and philosophy.
 
• The **Pitakas** are divided into three sections: Vinaya Pitaka (rules for monastic discipline), Sutta Pitaka (discourses), and Abhidhamma Pitaka (philosophical and doctrinal analysis).
